entities.name: Chandra Nalaar
entities.description: A pyromancer planeswalker who arrives on Zendikar to find her friends, rescues them from the demon's cavern and fights beside them.

entities.name: Gideon Jura
entities.description: A planeswalker whose buckler Chandra finds; he is captured by the demon and later helps defeat him.

entities.name: Jace Beleren
entities.description: A mind mage planeswalker held captive in the demon's cavern who guides Chandra by telepathy.

entities.name: Nissa Revane
entities.description: An elf planeswalker held captive with Gideon and Jace, who introduces herself to Chandra and helps defeat the demon.

entities.name: Tazri
entities.description: A tall, plate-armored human general sheltering wounded Zendikari in a ravine, who tells Chandra where the demon took Gideon.

entities.name: Ob Nixilis
entities.description: A demon who regained his planeswalker spark, awakened Kozilek and caused the destruction of Sea Gate, and who holds Gideon, Jace and Nissa captive.

entities.name: Chandra's parents
entities.description: Chandra's parents, killed when she was a child on Kaladesh, whose voices the demon mimics.

entities.name: Kozilek
entities.description: An Eldrazi titan whose spawn leave quadrangular ruin patterns across Zendikar.

entities.name: Ulamog
entities.description: An Eldrazi titan that wanders the landscape cutting ravines of blight.

entities.name: Eldrazi
entities.description: Eldrazi broodlings and drones of Kozilek's lineage that swarm over the land and guard the cavern.

entities.name: Zendikari scouts
entities.description: A small wounded party of scouts and foot soldiers, including a vampire and a kor, led by Tazri.

entities.name: Gideon's buckler
entities.description: A dented buckler shield that Chandra finds in the mud and carries as a weapon.

entities.name: Zendikar
entities.description: The plane being devoured by two titans.

entities.name: Kaladesh
entities.description: The plane where Chandra grew up and where her parents died.

entities.name: Sea Gate
entities.description: The city whose sea wall broke.

entities.name: Ob Nixilis's cavern
entities.description: A cavern between two peaks ringed by inward-pointing hedrons and blocked with an iridescent crust, where the demon holds his captives.

events.summary: Chandra searches the battlefield for Gideon and Jace while two titans wander the land and a swarm approaches.
events.quote: Too many to take on by herself.

events.summary: Chandra finds Gideon's dented buckler in the mud and recalls her parents' deaths on Kaladesh.
events.quote: It was a large buckler shield, wedged in a depression of mud.

events.summary: Tazri and wounded scouts hail Chandra from a ravine and tell her the demon took Gideon and two others to a cavern.
events.quote: The demon took him, and two others.

events.summary: Chandra lures the Eldrazi swarm away from Tazri's wounded in a cyclone of fire.
events.quote: A roaring cyclone made of churning flame whirled across the field ahead of her

events.summary: Chandra reaches the cavern, sees visions of her parents in the crust, and smashes the barrier.
Chandra finds Gideon, Jace and Nissa suspended in midair by enervating magic and challenges the demon.
The demon overpowers Chandra, drains her fire and mimics her parents' voices to make her give up.
events.quote: You've failed them, Chandra. Just like you failed us .

events.summary: Jace tells Chandra by telepathy to burn the Eldrazi drones, and she rallies and does so, freeing her friends.
events.quote: slamming into the Eldrazi drones that lurked near her friends.

events.summary: The captives vanish into invisibility and reappear as the demon seizes Gideon by the neck.
events.quote: The demon already had him by the neck, raising him up off his feet.

events.summary: Chandra, Gideon, Jace and Nissa attack the demon together and defeat him.
events.quote: All four of them attacked the demon simultaneously.

events.summary: Chandra's fire cyclone blasts the demon, who promises revenge across the planes and vanishes.
events.quote: The air folded in on itself, swallowing the demon, and he was gone.

events.summary: Chandra and the others reunite as Nissa introduces herself, and the Eldrazi swarm Chandra lured arrives.
events.quote: The Eldrazi swarm, the same horde that Chandra had lured away from Sea Gate, came skittering into the chamber

relations.note: Chandra searches for Gideon as a friend and he says he knew she would come.
Jace speaks to Chandra's mind to help her rescue them.
relations.quote: You've invisible, as far as he can see

relations.note: Chandra demands the demon free her friends or die and fights him.
Ob Nixilis holds Gideon captive and chokes him.
relations.quote: The demon squeezed on Gideon's throat, and Chandra could hear bone cracking.

relations.note: Tazri tends the wounded party as their General.
Ob Nixilis called Kozilek to rise.
relations.quote: Chandra remembered the demon calling the titan Kozilek to rise
